CORRECTED VO SCRIPT

Two hundred meters. That's how far Sukuna's shrine can reach.

The wheel lands on Malevolent Shrine, and you're standing inside it.

Rule one: run for the edge. Don't hide. There's no wall. The barrier is open.

Every step shrinks the distance. But the slashes don't wait for you. Cleave hunts anything with cursed energy. Dismantle shreds everything else.

Here's the terrifying trade. Sukuna leaves the escape route open, on purpose. That binding vow is what stretches the sure-hit range all the way to two hundred meters. In Shibuya, he deliberately shrank it to one hundred forty meters.

You're running. Two hundred... one hundred... fifty... The exit is right there, and one slash can still end it.

You cross the line. Silence.

Then, behind you... another shrine opens.

Was that escape route mercy, or the most vicious upgrade in Jujutsu Kaisen? Spin again. Comment the next character.

GLOBAL RULES (kept from v1)

  • Two camera states: LOCKED (rule, diagram, verdict) and POV-HANDHELD (survival). Never mixed inside one shot.
  • Handheld = breathing, not noise. One move per shot, cubic ease. Hits shake the world, not the camera.
  • Weight first: 4–6 frame anticipation, overshoot ≤ 3 frames; Sukuna never hurries, the slashes are the fast thing.
  • Slashes don't travel: 1-frame flash → 2-frame hold → separation. Debris falls straight down (no wind). Water ripples only from impacts.
  • Wheel = impulse + friction: starts fast, decays exponentially, stops dead.
  • Safe zones: HUD inside the top 8%, captions in the lower third, hero subject centre-weighted.

AUDIO MAP

  • Wheel clicks fire per segment edge crossing (S01) · range-ring stop = bass hit (S02) · pendulum-timed bells (S03, single bell S26).
  • Boundary shimmer hum (S05–S07, S18–S24) · slash = bright flash tick + low "thock", never a sword whoosh.
  • Freeze (S12): all SFX and music cut for 12 frames, VO kept · sprint footfalls at 3.7 Hz with breaths every second step, gasp at "fifty".
  • Drone bed 0.12 under the VO, drops OUT for Beat 7 and returns under the end card · true silence after the crossing until the bell.

AS BUILT (frames from this render)

PINNED COMMENT (post within 10 minutes)

Sukuna gave you an escape route… but that same choice let Malevolent Shrine reach 200 metres. Weakness or genius upgrade? Spin again — who should the wheel pick next? 👇

RECEIPTS

  • 200 m: Malevolent Shrine's maximum effective radius (JJK manga ch. 119; anime S2E17).
  • 140 m: the radius Sukuna deliberately used in Shibuya (ch. 119). Only the narrowing is stated; no motive is claimed.
  • Open barrier + escape route via binding vow enlarges the sure-hit range (ch. 119).
  • Cleave adjusts to the target's cursed energy and toughness; Dismantle is the default slash; inside the domain both hit continuously (ch. 119).
  • Sprint numbers (19.19 s 200 m WR, ~3.7–4.5 steps/s, ~0.09 s ground contact, 180+ bpm) are real physiology used only for motion timing.
  • HUD countdown is a labelled POV simulation built on the 200 m maximum, not a claim that the anime shows a measured run.
